name: Morpho Lodging: Glamping Operators
description: Independent glamping operators in the US (not Maine) with roughly 8 to 50 units (safari tents, domes, yurts, treehouses, airstreams, tiny cabins, covered wagons), or a portfolio of smaller sites. Often a newer entrant: an investor who bought land, a farm or ranch that added units, or an entrepreneur who started with a few tents and scaled. The owner makes the decisions and is reachable. Operating, or opening within six months with funding. Does NOT qualify: branded glamping chains (Under Canvas, AutoCamp, Postcard Cabins / Getaway, Collective Retreats, Huttopia, Firelight, Terramor), single-unit hosts with one or two listings, booking platforms and directories (Hipcamp, Glamping Hub, Airbnb), gear and tent manufacturers, event-only or festival glamping rental companies, RV parks that only mention glamping in passing (those belong to the RV park ICP), and concept-stage or unfunded developments. Unit count must be verified from the website (a stated number or a list of units).
offer_context: Morpho sells a fractional operations retainer and the AI visibility QuickScan: a direct booking channel and repeat-guest program instead of renting the customer from Hipcamp and Airbnb, turnover and housekeeping logistics across spread-out units, guest experience that holds at 20 units, seasonal staffing and cash flow, SOPs. Buying signals: strong Hipcamp or Airbnb presence with no direct booking site, recent unit expansion, housekeeping job posts, reviews about cleanliness or check-in, new listings in the last 12 to 24 months, adding a second site, building a direct booking website.

size.label: glamping units (tents, domes, yurts, cabins, treehouses)

options.owner_operator: one site, owner hands-on, often a farm, ranch or couple that built the units themselves
options.portfolio_owner_manager: two or more glamping sites, or glamping plus other lodging, with managers on site; growing fast
options.recent_acquirer: bought land or an existing property in the last 24 months and is converting or has just converted it to glamping; first full season under new ownership

options.independent_glamping_operator: independently owned glamping site renting multiple tents, domes, yurts, cabins or treehouses nightly
options.farm_or_ranch_with_glamping: working farm, ranch, vineyard or retreat property that runs a multi-unit glamping operation
options.branded_glamping_chain: Under Canvas, AutoCamp, Postcard Cabins, Getaway, Collective Retreats, Huttopia, Firelight, Terramor or similar multi-state brand
options.single_unit_host: one or two units, typically an Airbnb or Hipcamp host without a business operation
options.rv_park_or_campground: primarily an RV park or campground that happens to offer a few glamping units (belongs to the RV park ICP)
options.booking_platform_or_directory: a site that lists many glamping properties (Hipcamp, Glamping Hub, Airbnb, directories, blogs)
options.manufacturer_or_rental_gear: sells or rents tents, domes or glamping structures, or supplies event glamping
options.event_or_festival_glamping: temporary glamping rentals for weddings, festivals or events, no fixed site
options.pre_opening_or_concept: announced, crowdfunding or under construction with no operating units yet
